summary: ## **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** ## **Petition No: 261/MP/2023** ## **Coram:** ## **Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member Shri Ravinder Singh Dhillon, Member** ## **Date of Order: 26.2.2026** ## **In the matter of:** Petition under Section 79(1)(c), Section 79(1)(f) and Section 79(1)(k) of the Electricity Act, 2003 seeking revision of the date of operationalization of the long-term access granted to JSW Renew Energy Limited by Central Transmission Utility in terms of the Long-Term Access Agreement dated 17.9.2021 executed between Petitioner and CTUIL and align the date of operationalization with the Scheduled Commercial Operation Date of the project. ## **And in the matter of:** ## **JSW Renew Energy Limited** JSW Centre, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra East, Mumbai, Maharashtra-400051 ## **...Petitioner** **Vs.** ## **1. Central Transmission Utility of India Limited,** Floors No. 5-10, Tower 1, Plot No. 16, IRCON, International Tower, Institutional Area, Sector 32, Gurugram, Haryana – 122001 ## **2. Powergrid Corporation of India Limited,** Saudamini, Plot No. 2, Sector- 29, Gurugram, Haryana - 492001 ## **3. Solar Energy Corporation of India Ltd.,** 6[th] Floor, Plate-B, NBCC Office Block, Tower-2, East Kidwai Nagar, New Delhi -110023 ## ** Respondents** ## **Parties Present:** Shri Aditya K Singh, Advocate, JSWREL Order in Petition No. 261/MP/2023 **1** Shri Shubham Arya, Advocate, CTUIL Ms. Poorva Saigal, Advocate, CTUIL Ms. Pallavi Saigal, Advocate, CTUIL ## **ORDER** The Petitioner, JSW Renew Energy Limited (‘JSWREL’), has filed the present Petition seeking extension of the start date of connectivity and long-term access granted to the Petitioner by Respondent No. 1, Central Transmission Utility of India Limited (‘CTUIL’) from 31.3.2023 to 30.12.2023 due to extension granted by Respondent No. 3, Solar Energy Corporation of India (‘SECI’) in commissioning date of SECI IX Project, on account of various force majeure events beyond the control of the Petitioner. 2. The Petitioner has filed the present Petition seeking the following relief(s): ## _“a. Admit the present petition._ _b. Hold and declare that the Petitioner is entitled for extension in start date of Long-Term Access and Connectivity due to extension granted by SECI in commissioning date of SECI IX Project._ _c. Direct CTUIL to extend start date of Long-Term Access granted to Petitioner under the Long-Term Access Agreement dated 17.09.2021 from 31.03.2023 to 30.12.2023, on account of events beyond the control of the Petitioner; and_ _d. Direct CTUIL and PGCIL to not take any coercive actions during the pendency of the present Petition, including, but not limited to, levying any charges on account of operationalization of Long-Term Access and/ or any other financial or regulatory coercive action”._ 3. The matter was admitted on 19.1.2024 and was thereafter heard on 15.3.2024. During the hearing on 24.2.2026, the learned counsel for the Petitioner, on instructions, sought permission to withdraw the present Petition. The learned counsel for the Respondent, CTUIL, also did not oppose the Petitioner’s request for withdrawal of the Petition. Order in Petition No. 261/MP/2023 **2** 4. Considering the submissions of the learned counsels for the parties, the present Petition is disposed of as ‘withdrawn’. 5. Petition No. 261/MP/2023 is disposed of in terms of the above. Sd/Sd/Sd/- **(Ravinder Singh Dhillon) (Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.) Member Member Member** Order in Petition No. 261/MP/2023 **3** CERC Website S. No. 131/2026
